status: fixed design constants; not selected on outer-test outcomes

routing.spline_method_note: Curve-template spline. 'pchip' is the frozen v7 routing geometry (run_nhsn28_v7_final.py used build_curve_routing's own default). autodelphirf/engine.py previously hardcoded 'penalized_bspline', which flattened the curve/stage routing coordinates (point_ess 696 -> 11822) and collapsed RED's mean-AE gain over Null from 16.7% to 0.94% on nhsn28. spline_basis/spline_penalty apply only to 'penalized_bspline'.
routing.initial_lag_source: minimum lag in immutable full prepared-stream metadata

rr_delphirf.note: Current RevRoute Delphi-RF clusters mature-history location-lag tasks, selects the finest Tukey structural-gap cut, and predicts by frozen task lookup. No silhouette, minimum-cluster-row rule, soft weighting, or prediction-time trajectory routing is used. fit_max_rows is only a numerical fitting cap; it does not determine the task partition.

graph_fused_delphirf.graph: complete affinity-weighted graph within each prespecified lag group
graph_fused_delphirf.tuning: prespecified or training-only chronological validation; never random folds or outer-test outcomes

calibration_reliability.reference_policy: completed pre-evaluation inner rolling origins only

required_validation: report all settings with each run
report sensitivity analyses for routing bandwidth, history windows, and support thresholds
do not describe these constants as data-selected unless a completed inner-origin selection artifact is supplied
